finding: No test pins the new hyphen lookbehind in SUBSTRING_MATCH.
why: The existing hyphen-word negatives also end in a hyphen, so the trailing lookahead already rejects them. Deleting the lookbehind leaves every test green, although the regex would then flag a marker name that ends in an operator word.
fix: Add passing cases where the operator word ends the marker name.
evidence: The reviewer probe with the lookbehind removed: the two existing names match neither regex; a name ending in -in or -find matches only the mutated regex.
